title: Decision Table — The Charge Reading Stretch at Settlement on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Decision Table — The Charge Reading Stretch at Settlement on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Which lateness charges, returned-payment charges and give-backs on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan are read when the settlement figure is built depends on the plan's standing and on whether automatic payment is in force.

| The plan at the handling date | What is read |
|---|---|
| Stands past due | Every lateness charge, returned-payment charge and give-back booked since the plan began billing is read |
| Stands active, and automatic payment is in force on it | Only the charges and give-backs booked in the single whole month ending on the handling date are read |
| Any other case | The charges and give-backs booked in the term's repeat window of whole calendar months are read |

The past due row governs first: a past due plan reads its whole history of charges whether or not automatic payment is in force. The middle row is reached only by a plan standing active with automatic payment in force.

## The repeat window by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Repeat window, rolling whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

The repeat window stands at 6 whole calendar months on every promotional term.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A plan that began billing 14 whole calendar months ago carries a lateness charge booked 9 months ago and another booked last month.

- Standing past due: both charges are read, the stretch reaching back over all 14 months of billing.
- Standing active with automatic payment in force: only the charge booked in the single whole month ending on the handling date is read, so the 9-month-old charge is not.
- Standing active without automatic payment: the stretch is the term's 6 whole calendar months, so the charge booked last month is read and the one booked 9 months ago is not.
